sentences.en: I don't think that you did a very thorough job.
sentences.zh: 我不认为你做得非常彻底。

sentences.en: The verifications of the process have to be extremely thorough.
sentences.zh: 过程中的验证必须极其彻底。

sentences.en: Have you had a thorough medical checkup within the last year?
sentences.zh: 你在过去一年内做过全面体检吗？

senses.zh: 彻底的，全面的，充分的，彻头彻尾的，根本的，详尽的，严密的,十足的，考虑周到的,非常精确的，（对细节）不厌其烦的,绝对的，完善的prep.〈古〉同“through”n.英史专横政策
